visible_evidence: Hand pouring water into a measuring cup
Water level aligned with the 12 oz mark on the measuring cup

checks.text: Water is measured using a graduated measuring container

steps.text: Place-Place the dripper on top of a coffee mug
visible_evidence: Hand setting the dripper onto the rim of a coffee mug
Dripper resting stably on top of the coffee mug

checks.text: The dripper sits securely on top of the coffee mug rim

visible_evidence: Coffee beans placed onto a kitchen scale
Scale display showing the weight of the coffee beans

checks.text: Whole coffee beans are weighed on a scale

steps.text: Grind-Grind the coffee beans until the coffee grounds are the consistency of coarse sand, about 20 seconds
visible_evidence: Coffee beans placed in a grinder while the grinder operates
Ground coffee with a coarse, sand-like texture

checks.text: The coffee grounds have the consistency of coarse sand
The coffee beans are ground for about 20 seconds

steps.text: Prepare-Prepare the filter insert by folding the paper filter in half to create a semi-circle, and in half again to create a quarter-circle
visible_evidence: Hands folding a circular paper filter in half into a semi-circle
Hands folding the semi-circle in half again into a quarter-circle

checks.text: The paper filter is folded twice into a quarter-circle shape

visible_evidence: Hand pouring measured water into a kettle
Water inside the kettle

checks.text: The measured water is poured into the kettle

steps.text: Place-Place the paper filter in the dripper
visible_evidence: Hand inserting the folded paper filter into the dripper
Folded paper filter seated inside the dripper

checks.text: The folded paper filter is placed inside the dripper

steps.text: Boil-Boil the water. (While the water is boiling, assemble the filter cone)"
visible_evidence: Kettle powered on or placed on a heat source
Steam rising or boiling indicator active on the kettle

checks.text: The water in the kettle is brought to a boil

steps.text: spread-spread open filter in dripper to create a cone
visible_evidence: Fingers opening the layers of the folded paper filter inside the dripper
Paper filter spread into a cone shape lining the inside of the dripper

checks.text: The paper filter is spread open into a cone lining the dripper

steps.text: check-Once the water has boiled, check the temperature of the water. (The water should be between 195-205 degrees Fahrenheit or between 91-96 degrees Celsius. If the water is too hot, let it cool briefly.)
visible_evidence: Thermometer probe inserted into the hot water in the kettle
Thermometer display reading between 195-205 degrees Fahrenheit or 91-96 degrees Celsius

checks.text: A thermometer confirms the water temperature is between 195-205 degrees Fahrenheit or 91-96 degrees Celsius

steps.text: Transfer-Transfer the grounds to the filter cone
visible_evidence: Hand pouring or spooning coffee grounds into the paper filter cone
Coffee grounds sitting inside the filter cone in the dripper

checks.text: The ground coffee is placed inside the opened paper filter cone

steps.text: Pour-Pour a small amount of water into the filter to wet the grounds
visible_evidence: Kettle spout pouring a small stream of water onto the coffee grounds
Coffee grounds visibly darkened and wet

checks.text: A small amount of water is poured over the grounds so they are visibly wet

steps.text: Wait-Wait about 30 seconds for the coffee to bloom. (You will see small bubbles or foam on the coffee grounds during this step.)
visible_evidence: Pouring paused while wet grounds rest in the filter
Small bubbles or foam forming on the surface of the wet coffee grounds

checks.text: Pouring pauses for about 30 seconds after wetting the grounds
Small bubbles or foam appear on the surface of the wet coffee grounds

steps.text: pour-Slowly pour the rest of the water over the grounds in a circular motion. Do not overfill beyond the top of the paper filter
visible_evidence: Kettle moving slowly in a circular motion while pouring water over the grounds
Water level staying below the top edge of the paper filter

checks.text: The remaining water is poured slowly in a circular motion over the grounds
The water level remains below the top edge of the paper filter throughout the pour

steps.text: drain-Let the coffee drain completely into the mug before removing the dripper
visible_evidence: Water level in the dripper dropping until only damp grounds remain
Dripper lifted off the mug after dripping finishes

checks.text: All liquid drains completely into the mug before the dripper is removed

steps.text: Discard-Discard the paper filter and coffee grounds
visible_evidence: Hand lifting the used paper filter and grounds out of the dripper
Used filter and grounds placed into a waste or compost bin

checks.text: The used paper filter and coffee grounds are removed from the dripper and discarded
